description:
Analysis extent for Earthquake, Indonesia, 1 October 2018 (EQ20181001IDN): 31 features merged from 6 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Damage assessment of Pantoloan area in Central Sulawesi](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-of-pantoloan-area-in-central-sulawesi-2846)
- [Damage assessment of Taipa area in  Central Sulawesi](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-of-taipa-area-in-central-sulawesi-2845)
- [Damage assessment of Tawaeli area in Central Sulawesi](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-oftawaeli-area-in-central-sulawesi-2847)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.
